independent_technical_reasoning: ECRC bit 19 is an end-to-end integrity failure and is not interchangeable with BadTLP bit 6 or a corrected AER example. The expected DPC and resets change device state, so acceptance needs an ordered port-specific event timeline plus proof that the same BDFs and GPUs reappeared. Live topology is mandatory because device indices and example BDFs are not durable identities; one-shot execution limits the risk of compounding an incomplete recovery.
